title: Line chart draw-on
description: Use to show a trend over time: a smooth line with area fill that draws itself left to right. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
props: {values: number[]; labels?: string[]; title?: string; color?: string /*'#34d399'*/; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*50*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}
